# PetClues Concierge — The Genesis Vault

> True luxury is the absence of friction. PetClues is an Amex Centurion-style digital health archive and travel passport vault for pets.

## What is PetClues?
PetClues is a specialized B2B and B2C digital archive engineered for international pet relocation agencies, high-end breeders, and affluent pet owners. It eliminates physical folders and messy PDF attachments by manually digitizing veterinary histories into a unified, secure mobile dashboard.

## Core Capabilities
- **White-Glove Digitization:** Manual extraction and verification of veterinary records, rabies titers, and vaccination matrices from unstructured PDFs.
- **International Travel Passports:** Customs-ready digital dossiers structured for frictionless cross-border pet relocation (EU Pet Passports, DEFRA compliance, APHA standards).
- **Chronological Life Timeline:** An automated, read-only medical and life event narrative built from clinical records and daily care logs.
- **Lifetime Security:** Zero recurring consumer subscriptions; lifetime archive allocation secured forever.

## Target Audience & Industry Use Cases
- **Pet Relocation Agencies (IPATA Members):** Used as a client-facing post-relocation archive to deliver customs documents and health records cleanly.
- **Luxury Dog Breeders & Kennels:** Used as a digital handover vault pre-loaded with puppy lineage, microchips, and initial vaccination records.
- **Veterinary Concierge Specialists:** Mobile vets use PetClues to maintain clean, dark-mode medical dossiers for VIP clients.
